evidence.title: Frontier Models for Every Robot
evidence.excerpt: Frontier Models for Every Robot Announcing our API beta Published October 13, 2026 Loading… We are making our latest models available for training and inference through the Pi API beta . Deploying robots is challenging. Besides identifying the right use case and building the right hardware, developers need models intelligent enough to perform the task at hand. General-purpose robotic foundation models such as π 0 and π 0.5 offer a promising way to tackle this challenge. They provide a strong foundation of physical knowledge and capabilities, substantially reducing the data and effort needed to adapt to new tasks, environments, or robots. But adapting them still requires ML infrastructure, compute, and complex data pipelines, which are difficult in their own right. What if the latest and most powerful robotic foundation models could be adapted to each application through a simple and ready-made API? The Pi API does that for you. You upload data, launch fine-tuning on compute and infrastructure we manage, and access fine-tuned models via a hosted gateway to run inference.
